pieces.Text: The master may cast a divination spell with a target of "You" on the infiltrator (as a spell with a range of touch) instead of on herself. A master may cast spells on the infiltrator even if the spells normally do not affect creatures of the companion's type. Spells cast in this way must come from a class that grants a familiar. This ability does not allow the infiltrator to share abilities that are not spells, even if they function like spells.
